name: Daelkyr Half-Blood
sourceDistinctions: Symbiont Mastery adds 2 host HP per attachment and +4 to conflict saves, with no automatic bypass of Ego.
The throwing scarab provides one shard per round and no separate attack while attached. The damage dice follow the weapon entry and sample rogue.
The crawling gauntlet supplies a natural claw using host stats. Its standalone stat block is separate from the attached benefit.
portraitForm: Lysa Fenwick, an original Daelkyr Half-Blood scout with a throwing scarab
